band: 0.2% annual chance (500-year). FEMA zone X, subtype 0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD. This band lies OUTSIDE the 100-year zone, not on top of it.
source: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (S_FLD_HAZ_AR), retrieved 2026-08-03. Clipped to Memphis plus a margin that contains both 5-mile data-centre rings, dissolved, slivers under 5,000 m2 dropped, simplified to 3% topology-preserving for drawing. The simplified outline disagrees with the full-resolution one on about 1.5% of its area (2.7% for the 500-year band). Every published percentage is computed from the FULL-RESOLUTION geometry, never from this file.
